description: A compact list of groceries with a small picture and an add button.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Groceries as a compact list: a small square picture (or none), the name, the pack size, the price and an add
  button, in one or two columns. Axes: thumbs (show, hide), cols (1, 2), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type GroceryListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  thumbs?: "show" | "hide";
  cols?: "1" | "2";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  thumbs = "show",
  cols = "2",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<GroceryListProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="shopping-bag" :title="empty" />
    <List v-else
      tag="ul"
      :class="
        (cols as string) === '2' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 md:grid-cols-2'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1'
      "
      data-slot="items"
    >
      <ListItem
        v-for="d in dishes"
        :key="d.id"
        class="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-border py-2"
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <MediaFrame v-if="((thumbs as string) === 'show')" :alt="d.name" ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0" />
        <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ d.name }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl("{0} · {1}", d.weight, d.tag) }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
          {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
        </Inline>
        <AddIcon :label="tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)" />
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
